You greet people, say thank you and say goodbye.
ce/ci sound like “che/chee” (as in “cheese”), che/chi like “keh/kee”, ge/gi like “jeh/jee”, ghe/ghi like “geh/ghee”: cena, chiave, gelato, ghiaccio.
Double consonants are pronounced longer, with emphasis: nonno, notte, arrivederci.
Careful: the letter h is never pronounced: ho → “o”.
